discovery_source: NAAMP route-topology geometry v0.1 + compactness follow-up v0.1
target_design: Independent repeated fixed-station network with ordered stations and historical station-level taxon response.

primary_prediction.endpoint: mean pairwise station-separation excess conditional on exact k and frozen first-order station probabilities
primary_prediction.meaning: Active stations are more compact than conditionally independent placement predicts.

secondary_predictions: Compactness weakens from shallow to deep activation but remains negative in deep activation.
Recurrent high-use stations remain preferentially represented during deep activation.
required_boundaries: Freeze station-order geometry and historical station mapping before response readback.
Freeze exact-k conditional null and station probabilities before response readback.
Do not reinterpret non-replication as mechanism evidence.
Do not use NAAMP to retune thresholds after this prediction.
rc6_relation: No result from this external landscape test changes RC6 unless treated as a separate future study.
